detail.longDescription:
Discover everything the Minnesota State Fair has to offer with MN on a Stick! This app is your ultimate companion for navigating the fairgrounds and ensuring you don't miss out on any excitement.

Features:

Interactive Map: Find your way around the fair with ease using our built-in navigation.
Live Search: Quickly locate food vendors, events, and more.
Events Schedule: Stay up-to-date with all the activities and performances happening at the fair.
New Food: Explore the latest food offerings for this year.
Wishlist: Plan your fair experience by adding your must-see attractions and must-try foods.

MN on a Stick is your go-to app for making the most of your visit to the Minnesota State Fair!
